content.en: Inflation leads to a **decline in the real value of money**. As prices rise, the same amount of currency buys fewer goods and services. This phenomenon disproportionately affects individuals with **fixed incomes**, such as pensioners, as their nominal income remains stagnant while the cost of living increases.
